summary: Enova International filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting that subsidiary HWC Receivables 2023, LLC amended its revolving receivables securitization facility via an Omnibus Amendment with lenders and agents including Atlas Securitized Products Administration as administrative agent. The facility totals $535 million, split into $400 million Class A and $135 million Class B revolving loans priced at adjusted SOFR plus 2.75% and 8.50%, respectively. Revolving period ends March 2028; maturity March 2029. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch collateral performance and advance-rate compliance.
